description: This file contains the implementation of the LowOrderFee class, which is a PHP class defining the logic to calculate and add a low order fee to the totals in an OpenCart extension. The class extends the base Model class and includes a method 'getTotal' for computing and adding the fee based on cart subtotal and configuration settings.

classes.name: LowOrderFee
classes.description: A PHP class representing the LowOrderFee extension in the OpenCart platform, responsible for adding low order fees to the order total calculation.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates and adds the low order fee to the totals array if the cart subtotal is below a configured threshold, also handling related tax calculations.
